Dr. Fiona McAndrews
Benett Hill Medical Group
59 Embankment Street
Mitchelstown

26/09/2019

Dear Dr. McAndrews,

Re: Miss Eleanor Holmes, aged 8 [eight] years

Thank you for seeing Eleanor, who is being discharged today after near drowning. Her recovery has     Commented [DSM1]: Near-drowning
been successful and her condition requires your follow up.

Initially, on 24/08/2019, Eleanor presented to the Emergency Department in critical condition. She
was managed accordingly and over the following two weeks, her condition stabilized.

On 05/09/2019, she experienced dysarthria, difficulty concentrating, cough and headaches. Three
weeks later, Hher communication improved on speech therapy and she cleared the neurological
tests [her neurological examination was clear]. Her cough became better and she is currently on
paracetamol. [Other visits important details, her parents’ worry]

In light of the above, her parents were encouraged to check Eleanor’s cough, headaches and
concentration and were advised to refer to you for regular monitoring of her symptoms. Should she
develop pulmonary edema or her cough worsens, she should be immediately admitted to the
hospital. Kindly note that an appointment for neuropsychological tests to exclude potential delayed
hypoxia complications has been scheduled in a week and she would continue to attend speech
therapy for minor communication issues.

Thank you for taking care of Eleanor and I would be grateful if you would update me on her
condition. Should there be any queries please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours faithfully,
Doctor
